import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

url = ''https://jp.investing.com/economic-calendar/unemployment-rate-300''
headers = {
    ''User-Agent'': ''Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'',
    ''Accept'': ''text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8'',
    ''Accept-Language'': ''ja,en-US;q=0.7,en;q=0.3'',
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, ''html.parser'')

# HTMLの一部を出力

# 次回発表に関連する部分を探す

# スケジュール関連を探す

    print(m)

print(''---'')
# title属性を持つ要素を探す
for elem in soup.find_all(attrs={''title'': True}):
    title = elem.get(''title'', '''')
    if ''発表'' in title or ''release'' in title.lower():
        print(f''Title: {title}'')
''@")

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time

# ① ADP Research方式の調査
start = time.time()
try:
    # Step 1: Main Street Macro一覧を取得
    resp1 = requests.get(''https://www.adpresearch.com/category/mainstreet-macro/'', timeout=10)
    soup1 = BeautifulSoup(resp1.text, ''html.parser'')
    
    # NER Pulseの記事リンクを探す
    articles = soup1.find_all(''article'')
    ner_pulse_link = None
    for article in articles[:5]:  # 最初の5記事をチェック
        title = article.find([''h2'', ''h3''])
        if title and ''NER Pulse'' in title.get_text():
            link = article.find(''a'', href=True)
            if link:
                ner_pulse_link = link[''href'']
                break
    
    print(f''Step 1: Found NER Pulse article: {ner_pulse_link}'')
    
    if ner_pulse_link:
        # Step 2: 記事ページを取得
        resp2 = requests.get(ner_pulse_link, timeout=10)
        soup2 = BeautifulSoup(resp2.text, ''html.parser'')
        
        # xlsxリンクを探す
        xlsx_links = soup2.find_all(''a'', href=lambda x: x and ''.xlsx'' in x)
        for link in xlsx_links:
            print(f''Found xlsx: {link[""href""]}'')
    
    elapsed1 = time.time() - start
    print(f''ADP Research: {elapsed1:.2f}s'')
except Exception as e:
    print(f''Error: {e}'')
